run_test_hred_generation: run the HRED model training test to verify it learns basic overfit tasks with low perplexity
run_test_hred_greedy: run the HRED greedy decoding test on a multiturn candidate task using a pretrained model
run_test_hred_beamsearch: run the HRED beam search test to verify accurate response generation on multiturn tasks
test_hred_model_training: test the HRED model training pipeline with SGD optimizer and 100 epochs on an overfit task
test_hred_inference_modes: test the HRED model with both greedy and beam search inference modes on multiturn tasks
